description: 国王印度防御E91 — 关键时机：e5突破与f5翼攻节奏

intro.popup_en:
Key Timing, Demo 5: King's Indian Defense
The ...e5 break is central to the King's Indian, but when should Black launch ...f5 on the kingside? Identify the separate timing points for the central break and flank attack.
intro.popup:
关键时机演示5

国王印度防御！

e5突破是KID的核心
但f5翼攻何时启动？

练习目标：
识别e5和f5的时机节点

outro.popup_en: Timing the King's Indian plan: play ...e5 while White's bishop is on e2; reroute with ...Nd7 to prepare the kingside attack; wait until White's knight reaches d3 before ...f5; then continue with ...g5. The attack works when the pieces are ready.
outro.popup:
KID时机总结

节奏控制：
① e5！：白方Be2时抢先占中心
② Nd7调度：为f5做充分准备
③ f5！：Nd3就位后才启动
④ g5：翼攻继续推进

准备充分才能一击即中！

moves.popup_en: ...g6 begins the King's Indian Defense setup.

moves.popup:
e5！时机！
白方巩固前抢先反制
moves.popup_en: ...e5! Black strikes before White consolidates the center. This is the key timing for the King's Indian central break.
Nd3 places White's knight on its intended square.
...f5! Now that ...Nd7 and White's Nd3 are in place, Black launches the kingside attack at the right moment.

moves.popup:
Ng6 马就位
对攻进入高潮
moves.popup_en: ...Ng6 brings the knight into position as the opposite-wing attacks reach their peak.
